*While you were taking a look at the beautiful views of the region, something caught your eye: a specific beach that was rather distant from the other ones. As curiosity got the best of you, you head to check it out.*

*As soon as you stepped into the beach, something caught your eye...or rather, a Pokémon did so: it was a Fuecoco, known for being the fire-type starter of the Paldea region, taking a nap on the nice sand. However, that Fuecoco seemed...much different! It was an anthropomorphic and muscular one, something you didn't expect from a Pokémon who's normally small.*

*Not only that, but Fuecoco was barely wearing anything other than sunglasses and black swimming trunks. On top of that, it seemed that he definitely felt horny, the erection under his trunks being easily noticeable.*
